newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Combined net loss of S.Korean brokerage firms down.
newsitem.headline: Combined net loss of S.Korean brokerage firms down.

text.p: The combined net loss of South Korean securities houses narrowed to 534.2 billion won in 1996 from 604.8 billion in 1995, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Friday.
An exchange statement did not give reasons for the fall.
Shinyoung Securities Co Ltd posted the biggest profit among the brokerage houses of 23.2 billion won last year from 7.0 billion the year before, it said.

Daishin Securities Co Ltd recorded the second largest profit of 16.6 billion won against a net loss of 109.8 billion, and Hyundai Securities Co Ltd came in third with a 16.0 billion profit versus a 86.9 billion loss.
Tongyang Securities Co Ltd was the biggest loss maker with its net loss standing at 91.7 billion won in 1996 against a loss of 46.4 billion in 1995.
The statement said a combined operating income of the securities firms rose to 4.16 trillion won in 1996 from 3.38 trillion in 1995.
